g.text: LRR per bin: log2 of the bin's trimmed-mean depth over the member's autosomal median (GC- and
panel-corrected where applicable)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: step fit of the track (exact total-variation denoising)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: BAF: alt-allele read fraction at the member's heterozygous sites (subsampled)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: informative site whose alt allele is maternal (father 0/0, mother 1/1)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: informative site whose alt allele is paternal (father 1/1, mother 0/0)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: phased fraction at one site: maternal allele (child) or transmitted allele (parent), reference bias removed
phased fraction pooled over a window of sites (depth-weighted): 1/2 with equal homologue copy, 1/2 +/- d
along an event with the sign giving the parent (child: below 1/2 the paternal homologue is in excess,
above 1/2 the maternal; parent: below 1/2 the event lies on the untransmitted homologue, above 1/2 on
the transmitted one); hollow where the window deviates in two or more members (paralogy; excluded from
fits and scan)
child's maternal fraction at sites where the father is homozygous and the mother heterozygous; departs
from the main track where the child carries two different maternal homologues (maternal meiotic trisomy
or heterodisomy) and rejoins it after a crossover
the same at sites where the mother is homozygous and the father heterozygous; departs where the child
carries two different paternal homologues
parent's transmitted-allele fraction at sites where the child is heterozygous and the other parent
homozygous; departs from the main track where the child carries two different homologues of this parent
a crossover: where the auxiliary track's state (two different homologues, or one) changes along a
whole-chromosome event (dashed vertical line)
child's maternal copy number: the LRR step fit's copy number (2 x 2^LRR) times the maternal fraction's
step fit

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: child's paternal copy number, likewise

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: parent's copy number of the transmitted homologue, likewise

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: parent's copy number of the untransmitted homologue

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: called gain (line at the segment's mean LRR)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: called loss

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: called copy-neutral event: loss of heterozygosity or uniparental heterodisomy (drawn at LRR 0)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: event supplied with --events (bracket above the track)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: reference lines: LRR 0; BAF 1/2, 1/3 and 2/3; the centromere
